about: Present-day American Indian areas of the Cherokee, Chickasaw, Choctaw, Muscogee (Creek) and Seminole nations. The nations are not a historical layer that ends, so this one is drawn by default.
source: US Census Bureau, TIGER/Line Shapefile 2025, American Indian / Alaska Native / Native Hawaiian Areas (tl_2025_us_aiannh).
licence: Public domain, 17 U.S.C. 105 (work of the US federal government).
caveat: Statistical and legal-area boundaries, not a map of sovereignty and not a map of where a nation’s people live. Each shape carries the Census Bureau’s own word for what it is, because a reservation and an Oklahoma tribal statistical area are not the same kind of thing.
excluded_why: State-recognised groups with state reservations or state-designated statistical areas. They are not the federally recognised nations this layer is about and the Forest Service cession table does not list them among the present-day successors. Recorded here rather than dropped silently.
simplified: Simplified at 0.002 degrees; measured maximum displacement 0.31 km.
